cases.statement: One carrier: S027, a 3-year-old boy referred for suspected IPEX (FOXP3-negative) and tested on a 462-gene immune panel.

people.label: S027
people.key_phenotypes: watery diarrhea; eczema; failure to thrive; thyroid autoantibodies without overt thyroiditis; elevated IgE (IPEX-like presentation, age 3 y)

phenotype_specificity.statement: Presentation is IPEX-like (enteropathy, eczema, autoimmunity). FOXP3 had been excluded before study entry, and the patient was sequenced on a 462-gene immune-disease panel (cohort-level methods). No other candidate variant is listed for S027.

quotes.quote: | S027 | 3 y | M | TNFAIP3 | AI, II | no | AD | Watery diarrhea, eczema, failure to thrive, autoantibodies to thyroid (without frank thyroiditis), elevated IgE. |
Patients were eligible for the study if referred to SCH with clinical signs suggestive of IPEX, and hence for genetic analysis of FOXP3, but with no FOXP3 mutation identified.

We designed an oligonucleotide-based sequencing panel encompassing the coding exons, 5’ and 3’ untranslated regions, and flanking intronic regions of 462 known and candidate genes for immune-mediated disease (Table EI).

segregation.statement: not reported (no relatives tested are mentioned for S027). Cohort-level: only probands were available for initial analysis.

quotes.quote: Second, only probands were available for initial analysis, although a few families were re-contacted through the referring providers.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Single-nucleotide deletion predicted to cause a frameshift (batch: p.(Val377CysfsTer9)). The authors call it truncating and cite haploinsufficiency as the disease mechanism.

concerns: Protein notation differs: the paper writes p.S376fs, while the batch predicts p.(Val377CysfsTer9) from c.1128del. The paper writes the cDNA as c.1127delC, probably the same deletion at a different position in a C repeat. The paper's hg19 position is chr6:138199709. The panel should confirm.
The paper does not state a transcript.
Table-level evidence only. There is no case narrative or parental testing.
The phenotype is IPEX-like rather than the Behçet-like picture usually described. This is a referral-bias cohort.
notes_for_panel: The Table III row includes the authors' own ClinVar-status column ('ni' = no information on ClinVar). It is quoted as part of the row and was not looked up.
